Welcome to Stack Supplements🙌

What We Do

We have spent over 2+ years formulating a range of unique and effective flavoured oral spray supplements for Focus, Sleep, Calm & Immunty. See below for more details on our sprays! 

Fast Focus (Strawberry Lemonade Flavour)

A unique set of efficacious ingredients stacked together with the purpose of promoting concentration and improving brain health. Whether it’s work, sports or leisure-based tasks. Focus is the key to outperform.

How To Use

-For MAXIMUM Effectiveness: Take 2 sprays under the tongue then swallow after 30 seconds.

-For ALTERNATIVE Use: Mix 2 sprays into your water, hot beverage, juice or smoothie of choice.

Ingredients

  • N-Acetyl L-Tyrosine: This amino acid increases dopamine (the key neurotransmitter for focus, motivation and concentration). In short, more dopamine = more focus and laser-sharp concentration.
  • Lions Mane (10:1 Extract): A unique mushroom that contains compounds that stimulates nerve growth factor, which helps rebuild and protect the neuron connections in the brain vital for memory and cognitive function.
  • Alpinia Galanga (10:1 Extract): This rare ginger is used by Thai boxers to increase their mental energy, alertness and focus. This is thanks to it's active compounds Galangin and Alpinone.
  • Polygala Tenuifolia (20:1 Extract): As a natural Monoamine Oxidase Inhibitor (MAOI), it blocks the breakdown of focus-enhancing neurotransmitters like dopamine allowing for longer periods of concentration and increased memory.
  • Ginkgo Biloba (10:1 Extract): This herb is over 200million years old. It's great for increasing blood flow and oxygen directly to the brain allowing for heightened focus.
  • Vitamin B6: A vital vitamin involved in the production of dopamine, increasing focus levels. It's also great for overall cognitive health. We use the premium more bioavailable form to further increase its effects.

Due to the versatility of our spray, it makes it a truly a unique supplement unlike anything else. Even going down to the detail of the pump/ spray head which doses exactly 1ml per pump ensuring the serving size is accurate and reliable unlike cheper sprays and tinctures. 

Our Formulation is also a custom blend utilising the potent forms of each ingredients making it stand out to anything someone can get out there. 

Whether you want to push the ingredients, versatility of use or taste as the USP(s) in your marketing, this is a revolutionary product to market and help people optimise their health. Join the growing community and get commision along the way!
